Source: NCDC Cholera Situation Report Series - systematic sweep of all 93 archive issues (LGA tables)
Description: The complete NCDC cholera situation report archive - 93 PDFs spanning September 2017 to March 2025 - was downloaded and every top-N LGA table parsed. NCDC re-ranks that table in every issue, and it is a top 14, 15 or 20 depending on the issue, so an LGA can appear in one issue and vanish from the next purely because others overtake it. Mining only the year-end issue therefore loses LGAs systematically. The sweep recovered 157 distinct (state, LGA, year) triples; rows are created only for those not already in the file, taking the largest value across all issues for that triple, and the specific issue and epidemiological week are recorded in each row. Two parsing hazards were handled: 'Cross River' wraps across two lines in several issues and parses as a bare 'River', and the week-36 2021 issue mis-assigns Birnin Kudu (a Jigawa LGA) to Kano. Every value was checked against its state's full-year total before committing. [AGENT 7 POST-RUN AUDIT 2026-09-22] URL REVIEWED AND JUDGED APPROPRIATE, WITH A CAVEAT. The URL is the NCDC situation-report archive index rather than a single document. For this entry that is defensible rather than defective: the entry describes a programmatic sweep across all 93 published issues and no single PDF could represent it, and each of the 39 dependent rows names the specific issue and epidemiological week it came from in its own processing_notes, so every value remains traceable to one document. Many of those individual issues are ALSO registered here at document level with direct PDF URLs (metadata 83-133 among others), which is where a reader should go to verify a single value. URL reachability could not be tested on this pass: ncdc.gov.ng was returning Cloudflare 522 site-wide on 2026-09-22, its root included, so all 71 ncdc.gov.ng URLs in this metadata file are UNVERIFIED-INCONCLUSIVE rather than broken.
